label: Activate member triggers
description: Turn on a member's own triggers (the ones that exist once per member). A trigger reading the member's infra copy needs that copy running first. Triggers already on stay as they are.

inputs.name: member
inputs.description: The member, by the id your program uses for them (`user-42`).

inputs.name: only
inputs.description: Only these triggers, named the way the program writes them. Every per-member trigger when not wired.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers are on. Wire it into the `_should_flow` of what must happen after.
